ValidationRule.description: This validation ensures that complete education details are captured for candidates whose Source is Referral, Internal, or External.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( OR( ISPICKVAL(Source__c, "Referral"), ISPICKVAL(Source__c, "Internal"), ISPICKVAL(Source__c, "External") ), OR( ISBLANK(Highest_Qualification__c), ISBLANK(Institute_Name__c), ISBLANK(Year_Of_Passing__c), ISBLANK(GPA_Percentage__c) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Education details are mandatory for Referral, Internal, and External candidates.
